description: Four original eleven-minute recordings, not downloaded field recordings. Runtime adds the existing twelve species bird profiles and crossfades randomized playback positions.
redistribution: Generated from mathematical signals and seeded noise without third-party recordings; included for local offline redistribution with Neon Pursuit.

coastline.source: Original seeded procedural synthesis; no downloaded audio
coastline.design: Long ocean swells, breaking wash and foam, low distant surf, gusting tree wind, scattered gull/tern-like calls.

tundra.source: Original seeded procedural synthesis; no downloaded audio
tundra.design: Soft snow wind, narrow ice whistles, sparse ice crackles and drifting snow hiss, distant northern bird-like calls.

desert.source: Original seeded procedural synthesis; no downloaded audio
desert.design: Dry broad wind with slow gusts, sand hiss, irregular insect pulses, sparse raven/dove/hawk-like calls.

jungle.source: Original seeded procedural synthesis; no downloaded audio
jungle.design: Layered rain canopy and leaf drips, low distant rain wash, insect choruses with independent pulses, tropical bird-like calls.
